newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 6.28 points at 5,894.74 on Monday ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy-making meeting on Tuesday.
** Indonesia announced its next major privatisation plan on Monday, saying it will divest up to a 25 percent-stake in giant state-owned bank PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) later this year.
** Eleven hotel projects in Jakarta worth 500 billion rupiah are reported to be delayed partly due to financing problems.
** State-owned PT Danareksa Finance and PT Danareksa Fund Management plan to launch margin financing in an effort to woo Indonesians to invest in local stock markets.
** The Jakarta composite index rose 1.17 points, or 0.21 percent, to close at 570.17 points on Monday on the back of strong rises in car manufacturer Astra International.
** Brokers said they expected Jakarta share prices to be mixed on Tuesday ahead of a meeting of the United States Federal Reserve.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,318.50/19.00 in early trade against an opening of 2,318.50/19.50.
** Can maker Pelangi Indah Kanindo following an encouraging debut on Monday.
** Packaging firm Super Indah Makmur on reports of bonus shares and a stock split.
** Tyre firm Gajah Tunggal ahead of a shareholders meeting later on Tuesday.
** Astra on continued market talk of a possible takeover and rights issue. The firm has denied comment on the takeover talk and said there was no plan to announce a rights issue.
** Property firm Jababeka on talk it has signed a deal with a Singapore-based firm to develop and operate an industrial park in West Java.
